prompt.generated_prompt_string: Ultra-realistic four-panel lifestyle portrait of the same adult man in a real outdoor urban environment. He has short tousled dark hair, a calm confident expression, authentic skin texture with visible pores and slight imperfections, and wears a neutral hoodie layered under a black denim jacket with blue jeans and white sneakers. Construct a 2x2 grid: leaning against a brick wall, walking down the sidewalk, seated on a stoop, and looking back toward camera. Keep soft natural daylight, a softly blurred city background, realistic pedestrians and distant traffic, candid posture, true-to-life color, a 50mm prime lens at f/1.8, ISO 100, balanced highlights and shadows, subtle film grain, and a genuine editorial lifestyle-photography feel.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor, recognizable bystanders, text, watermark, logo, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, extra fingers, deformed, mismatched panel identity
